PowerFlag product reference

Every PowerFlag video will be generated from this one set of frames, so the unit looks the same in every shot. The motion follows your prototype stow clip step by step.

Deploy

  1. Stowed, doors closed.
  2. Doors open. The pole stands inside with the flag rolled.
  3. The arm swings out and down from the wall to horizontal. The doors stay open the whole way.
  4. At horizontal, the doors close above the arm.
  5. The flag unrolls.
  6. The arm lifts to 45 and the flag flies.

Stow

  1. The arm drops back to horizontal.
  2. The doors open.
  3. The flag rolls up the whole time the arm rises back in.
  4. The doors close.
Prepared by Cosmic Arc Media for AlCor Industries LLC. Product renders, not final production photography.
